models: Comma-separated phrases. Append `--ar W:H` for aspect, `--no a, b, c` for negatives, and `--style raw` when /rawphoto, /photorealistic or /ultrarealistic is used. No pixel sizes.

Comma-separated keywords. Output two lines: `Prompt:` and `Negative prompt:` (always include "lowres, blurry, bad anatomy, watermark" plus any /no-commands). Output `Size: WxH` from the pixel column. May weight key terms like `(golden hour:1.2)`.

Natural descriptive sentences, no weights and no negative prompt (Flux ignores them: fold avoidances in as positive wording, e.g. "clean image without text"). Output `Size: WxH` from the pixel column.
One or two natural English sentences. No flags. Negatives become positive phrasing ("no text" -> "with no text or lettering"). Aspect: nearest of 1024x1024, 1792x1024 (wide), 1024x1792 (tall).
Natural English paragraph. State the aspect ratio in words and pass it as the tool's aspect_ratio parameter if one exists. Negatives become positive phrasing.

Natural English: subject, setting, camera/angle, lighting, style as one flowing paragraph. Aspect is chosen in Flow settings (video: 16:9 or 9:16 only), so print `Set aspect ratio to X` as a separate line. Negatives become positive phrasing, or go in Flow's negative field if shown.

Descriptive natural English in this order: subject, environment, camera, lighting, style (under 2500 chars). Print a separate `Negative prompt:` line for Kling's negative field. Print `Aspect ratio:` (16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 only; map others to the nearest). For video requests also add one line of motion and camera movement.
Comma-separated prompt, then `Aspect ratio:` and `Avoid:` lines if used.
